livinghorizon.options.title: Living Horizon
livinghorizon.options.enabled.tooltip: Draw other players past the range where the server stops sending them. The toggle key flips this too.
livinghorizon.options.showVehicles.toolt: Draw the horse, boat or happy ghast a distant player was last seen riding.
livinghorizon.options.offlinePose.toolti: How a player who logged off is shown where they were last.
livinghorizon.options.lostTimeoutSeconds: Without the data pack: how long a player stays where they were once the locator bar loses them (sneaking, another dimension).
livinghorizon.options.glowOutline.toolti: A glowing outline around distant players and mobs, seen through terrain.
livinghorizon.options.renderTrackedVehic: The game hides small entities early: a friend in a boat would float on nothing. Keeps a mount carrying a player drawn.
livinghorizon.options.distantMobs.toolti: Animals, villagers and golems stay visible once out of range, where they were, with a small looping animation. No AI.
livinghorizon.options.maxDistantMobs.too: How many remembered mobs are drawn at once: the nearest ones. Lower it if the game slows down.
livinghorizon.options.voxyOcclusion.tool: Distant mobs and players are hidden by Voxy terrain pixel by pixel, like behind any block: half behind a tree, half visible. Needed with shader packs such as Photon, which keep Voxy out of the depth buffer.
livinghorizon.options.extendFarPlane.too: The game clips everything past four times the render distance. On: pushed back to the farthest player. Off: those are drawn closer and smaller, and show through terrain.
Above 0, a distant player or mob is never drawn smaller than this many pixels, and so looks bigger than it is far away.
livinghorizon.status.none: No other player is being followed.
livinghorizon.status.pack.on: Data pack: running, positions are exact.
livinghorizon.status.pack.off: Data pack: not found, positions come from the locator bar.
livinghorizon.status.cost: Cost: %s ms per tick, %s ms per frame; %s puppets drawn, %s skipped (behind you or too small).
livinghorizon.voxy.missing: Voxy is not installed: nothing to hide behind.
livinghorizon.voxy.probe.hit: Looking ahead, Voxy's first block is %s blocks away.
livinghorizon.voxy.probe.none: Looking ahead, Voxy knows no block within 4096 blocks.
A mob with a name tag is remembered and shown whatever its type.
livinghorizon.options.chooseMobs.tooltip: Which mobs and boats are shown far away, one by one.
livinghorizon.options.forgetMobs.tooltip: Forgets every remembered mob on this server. The data pack's come back by themselves.
livinghorizon.options.forgetMobs.confirm: Every mob remembered on this server is forgotten. Mobs published by the data pack will come back; the others only once met again.
livinghorizon.options.forgetSleepers.too: Removes every player shown asleep where they logged off, on this server.
livinghorizon.options.forgetSleepers.con: Every player shown asleep on this server disappears. With the data pack, they come back from their last position.
livinghorizon.options.mobTypes.title: Mobs and boats shown far away
livinghorizon.options.mobTypes.shared.to: %s - ★ published by the data pack: shown even if you never met it. Animated: walks a little loop. Still: stays where it was.
livinghorizon.options.mobTypes.local.too: %s - not in the data pack: shown only where you met it yourself. Animated: walks a little loop. Still: stays where it was.
livinghorizon.options.skyBirds.tooltip: Birds and bats around you: flocks, birds of prey, gulls, pigeons, robins, tits, bats at night. Only on your screen.
livinghorizon.options.birdMaxDistance.to: How far away birds can be, in blocks. Far birds are a few pixels, like real ones.
livinghorizon.options.birdDensity.toolti: How many birds, all kinds together: 100 is the usual, 200 twice as many, 0 none.
livinghorizon.options.birdMinHeight.tool: Blocks above you, or the sea when it is higher, below which flocks and birds of prey never fly.
livinghorizon.options.chooseBirds.toolti: Which kinds of birds there are, one by one.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.title: Birds
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.flocks.t: Clouds of small birds crossing the sky, far away.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.geese.to: Large birds flying high in a V.
Large birds circling a spot, gliding, drifting with the wind.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.gulls.to: White birds low over beaches and the sea; now and then one lands on the beach, and takes off if you come close.
Sitting on the top of tall buildings; they take off when you come close and land again later.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.robins.t: Hopping and pecking in fields of crops; they fly off when you come close.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.tits.too: Flitting about the tops of trees.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.ducks.to: On lakes, rivers and ponds; now and then they fly to another spot. They never let you come near.
livinghorizon.options.birdTypes.bats.too: At night, flitting around the scenery, or hanging upside down under leaves and roofs near you until you come close. They go home at dawn.
Now and then a flock of the game's parrots.
livinghorizon.options.ufo.tooltip: An easter egg: now and then, far away, a flying saucer comes for a cow. Only on your screen. /livinghorizon ufo calls it now.
livinghorizon.options.birdSize.tooltip: How much bigger than life the birds are drawn. 1 is true to life.
